intro_1.text: Welcome, traveler. I'm glad you're here.

intro_2.text: Make yourself comfortable. Sit back, or lie down, and let your shoulders soften.

intro_3.text: In front of you is a small light. It breathes slowly. Breathe with it.

intro_4.text: Good. With every breath, your body grows heavier and warmer, and your mind grows lighter.

lift_1.text: Now imagine a second you, made of light, resting quietly inside your body.

lift_2.text: It is weightless. It wants to rise.

lift_3.text: Let it float upward, gently, the way a feather rises on warm air.

lift_4.text: Below you, your body rests, safe and peaceful. You can return to it whenever you wish.

ocean_1.text: We are drifting above a quiet ocean at sunset. Feel how easily you move.

ocean_2.text: Somewhere nearby is a golden light. It is the light of Truth. Look around for it, and when you find it, rest your eyes on it until it comes to you.

ocean_hint.text: Look around slowly. The golden light is waiting for you.

ocean_got.text: Truth. The light that sees clearly, without fear.

forest_1.text: Now we drift into a forest at night, alive with fireflies.

forest_2.text: Among them flies a bright green light, wild and free. It is the light of Freedom. Find it.

forest_hint.text: Look between the trees. Freedom never stays still for long.

forest_got.text: Freedom. The light that no one can cage.

aurora_1.text: Higher now, above silent mountains, where the sky itself is dancing.

aurora_2.text: In the dancing sky glows a warm, rose-coloured light. It is the light of Love. Find it.

aurora_hint.text: Look up. Love is shining in the open sky.

aurora_got.text: Love. The light that connects every living thing.

earth_1.text: Now we rise beyond the sky, and there is our home, planet Earth, glowing in the dark.

earth_2.text: One light remains, a bright violet light near the Earth. It is the light of individual Sovereignty, your right to choose your own path. Bring it home.

earth_hint.text: The last light is close to the Earth. Look near its edge.

earth_got.text: Sovereignty. The light that belongs to you alone.

finale_1.text: Now watch. Truth, Freedom, Love and Sovereignty, together, surround the Earth.

finale_2.text: This is what Pro-Life and Earth Avatars do. Each of us carries these four lights, and when enough of us shine together, the whole world can change its course.

return_1.text: It is time to return. Slowly, gently, drift back toward your body.

return_2.text: Feel your weight again. Your hands. Your feet. Your breath.

return_3.text: Bring the four lights back with you. They are yours to keep.

return_4.text: Take one more deep breath, and when you are ready, open your eyes.

return_5.text: Thank you for traveling with me. I'll see you on the next journey.
